theme_strategy: Light mode primary to ensure optimal readability for older demographics and align with an eco-conscious, transparent brand identity. High contrast is non-negotiable.

typography.instructions: Use Atkinson Hyperlegible for all body and UI text due to its exceptional readability for visually impaired/older users. Use Outfit for headings to provide a warm, geometric, human-centric feel. Base font size should be large (text-lg).

scale.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#144D36]

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Flat Solid surfaces. NO Glassmorphism (it refracts data and reduces contrast, making it harder for older users). Cards should have white backgrounds with a subtle 1px border (#E2E0D8) and soft shadow (shadow-sm).
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded elements convey approachability. Use rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for primary buttons, and rounded-2xl for large layout blocks.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid clutter. Gap between major sections should be py-16 or py-24.

buttons.primary: bg-[#144D36] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-lg font-semibold hover:bg-[#0F3A29] transition-colors focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-[#C85A40] focus-visible:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#C85A40] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-lg font-semibold hover:bg-[#A94A33] transition-colors focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-[#144D36] focus-visible:ring-offset-2
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#144D36] text-[#144D36] rounded-full px-6 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-lg font-semibold hover:bg-[#144D36] hover:text-white transition-colors focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-[#C85A40]

badges.vat_relief: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E8F5E9] text-[#1B5E20] text-sm font-bold border border-[#A5D6A7]
badges.condition: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#FFF3E0] text-[#E65100] text-sm font-bold border border-[#FFCC80]

header.background: Solid white (#FFFFFF) with a 1px bottom border (#E2E0D8). DO NOT use transparent backgrounds as it harms legibility when scrolling.
header.navigation: Desktop links must be clearly visible, large (text-lg), and have an underline on hover/focus. Include a prominent 'Donate' CTA.

shop_grid.layout: Grid layout: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop (gap-8).
shop_grid.card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E2E0D8] overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
shop_grid.image_container: aspect-square w-full bg-[#F9F8F6] relative border-b border-[#E2E0D8]
shop_grid.title: text-xl font-bold text-[#144D36] mb-2 line-clamp-2

forms.inputs: w-full rounded-lg border border-[#8C8C8C] bg-white px-4 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-lg text-[#1A1A1D] focus:border-[#144D36] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#144D36]

homepage.hero: Warm, welcoming section. Split layout: Left side bold typography (H1: 'Making care sustainable') and plain English subtext. Right side: large, high-quality image of care community with rounded-2xl corners. Background: #F9F8F6.
homepage.four_routes: Bento-style 2x2 grid (or 1x4 on mobile) representing the 4 core actions: Buy, Donate, Get Help, Sustainability. Each card needs a clear icon/image, large text, and a distinct CTA button.
homepage.impact_stats: Large, high-contrast numeric counters (e.g., 'Items saved from landfill', 'Grants awarded') using the secondary color (#C85A40).

admin_dashboard.sidebar: bg-[#144D36] text-white, clear icons, large hit areas (min-h-[44px]).
admin_dashboard.tables: bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E2E0D8], high contrast alternating row colors (white / #F9F8F6). Action buttons clearly visible.

accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 48x48 pixels.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus states are MANDATORY. Use focus-visible:ring-4 with a high-contrast color (e.g., focus-visible:ring-[#C85A40]).
accessibility.color_contrast: Ensure a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for text. Do not rely on color alone (e.g., add icons to error messages).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Avoid auto-playing carousels or heavy parallax. Keep transitions under 200ms.
accessibility.language: Use Plain English. Avoid jargon like 'Checkout Protocol'; use 'Secure Checkout' or 'Pay Now'.

community_activities.description: Caregiver assisting two elderly women knitting, smiling.

sustainability.description: Person holding a small plant in soil with their hands.

instructions_to_main_agent: Include 'data-testid' attributes on ALL interactive and key informational elements for automated testing (e.g., data-testid='shop-now-btn').
Never use generic AI placeholder images; use the provided image URLs or standard clear lucide-react icons.
Do not use generic gradients or 'SaaS' purple/blue aesthetics. Stick strictly to the Forest Green (#144D36) and Terracotta (#C85A40) palette.
Implement the UI using Tailwind CSS and raw HTML where Shadcn components feel too rigid for marketing pages, but use Shadcn for forms, dialogs, and admin tables.
Ensure all fonts are imported correctly (Atkinson Hyperlegible and Outfit) and applied via Tailwind configuration.
Always use 'lucide-react' for icons. Ensure icons are large and recognizable (e.g., size={24} or size={28}).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create depth through layered design elements (borders + soft shadows), NOT heavy box-shadows or dark gradients.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not disrupt the natural left-to-right reading flow.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons.
Use 2x spacing compared to standard defaults. Cramped designs fail accessibility standards for older adults.
